bias.en: Pullback · under the 100 and 200-day, on the 10-day
bias.zh: 回落 · 低于 100 日和 200 日均线，位于 10 日均线上

read.en: Meta fell 0.8% on Nov 12 to $623.61, trading $618.92–630.28 on light volume (0.42x the 20-day average). It is above the rising 10-day ($622.3) and below the rising 5-day ($629.1), the 200-day ($631.3), rising 100-day ($636.1) and 30-day ($671.9). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($591.21), and RSI is 42.1.
read.zh: Meta 11月12日下跌 0.8%，收于 $623.61，盘中区间 $618.92–630.28，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.42 倍）。股价位于上行的 10 日均线（$622.3）上方，上行的 5 日均线（$629.1）、200 日均线（$631.3）、上行的 100 日均线（$636.1）和 30 日均线（$671.9）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看涨（$591.21），RSI 为 42.1。

read.en: The close slipped under the 5-day, and the $630.28 high stopped at the $630 Nov 9 low under the 200 and 100-day. Resistance is $629–636, then $643.1–648.5 (Nov 4–11 highs) and $672–681 (30-day, Oct 22 high). Support is $618.9–622.3 (10-day, Nov 3 close, Nov 12 low), then $606.4–610.1 and $583.8–591.2 (SAR, Nov 5 low). A close above $636 would target $643–648; below $618.9, $606–610.
